notes: Engineering Evolution Lab lifecycle · founder-authorised design 2026-09-12. DESIGN ONLY. Lifecycle is a state machine · every transition requires evidence · no auto-advancement. Four terminal outcomes: APPROVED_STANDARD · REJECTED · HOLD · SUPERSEDED.

states.meaning: a candidate practice has been named · founder-whitelisted source · no research yet
candidate has scope · applicability · initial rationale
citations gathered · prior art documented · counterexamples enumerated
candidate has a Lab implementation · deterministic · sandboxed · never touches NEX1
at least 3 independent benchmark suites executed · results recorded as EvidenceRecords
founder-authored adversarial fixtures applied · counterexamples included
NEX2 review complete · verdict ∈ {ACCEPT_NEX1(N/A here) · PROPOSE_ALTERNATIVE · BOTH_NEED_REVISION · REQUEST_EVIDENCE · HOLD}
NEX3 arbitration complete · verdict ∈ {NEX1_BETTER · NEX2_BETTER · EXISTING_CODE_BETTER · BOTH_INFERIOR · HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE · USER_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED}
arbitration is advisory · founder review queued · never auto-authorised

terminal_outcomes.meaning: founder ADR authorises · candidate becomes EngineeringStandard · emitted to Feed
founder-authorised rejection · reason recorded · candidate cannot re-enter without new evidence
candidate stays in queue · needs additional evidence · not auto-advanced
newer candidate covers the same practice space · this one closed

transitions.requires: any state may pause · never auto-resumes · founder or evidence updates required to resume
founder-authored supersession · references new candidate id

invariants: no auto-advancement · every transition requires cited evidence or founder action
APPROVED_STANDARD is only reachable via FOUNDER_REVIEW · never earlier
no state may be skipped · e.g. CANDIDATE cannot jump to APPROVED_STANDARD
REJECTED candidates cannot silently re-enter · new evidence + founder authorisation required
HOLD is honest · not silent failure · candidates in HOLD are visible in the queue
SUPERSEDED preserves history · original candidate remains queryable
no LLM in any transition path
no auto-learning in any state · Lab observes · researches · benchmarks · never mutates NEX1
